description: Modbus TCP to Modbus RTU/ASCII gateway with 10 configurable digital inputs/outputs and an internal memory shared between masters
source: Exemys, EGW1-IA3-MB Manual del Usuario, Rev. 13
notes: The internal Modbus slave answers at its own ID (240 by default, changed in the Advanced page): it serves the digital inputs and outputs (functions 01, 02, 05 and 15) and the internal memory (holding registers 40001 to 41000).

The inputs and outputs are numbered 1 to 10 and split by the 'Inputs' quantity set in the web configuration: with 7 selected, inputs 1 to 7 are discrete inputs 10001 to 10007 and outputs 8 to 10 are coils 00008 to 00010.
The gateway's main function, converting Modbus TCP to serial Modbus, passes requests to the devices on the serial side and has no registers of its own.
Register numbers are those of the manual (40001 is the first holding register), counted from 1 (address_base 1).
Written from the manufacturer's manual (in Spanish); not tested on a device.
